name: List All Leads Notes
description: Returns all notes for a lead that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[GuestCardId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by GuestCardId. All GET requests must include a filter for [GuestCardId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter lead notes last updated at or after this date-time. All GET requests must include a filter for [GuestCardId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: page[number]
queryFilters.description: Page number for pagination. Default is 1.

queryFilters.name: page[size]
queryFilters.description: Page size for pagination. Default is 1000.

responseFields.name: data
responseFields.description: Array of lead note objects meeting the filter criteria

responseFields.name: data[].Body
responseFields.description: A brief informative message about the lead note. A lead note cannot exceed 63,535 characters.

responseFields.name: data[].EntityId
responseFields.description: The unique identifier of the Guest Card to which the note will be attached

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the lead note's details were last updated

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the note associated with the guest card

responseFields.name: data[].NoteId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the note associated with the guest card. Deprecated in favor of Id.

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
